description: Fixed reflective essay set with raw dream narratives for Phase 1 context-v1 versus Phase 2 narrative-first context-v2 comparison.

cases.reviewer_focus: A coherent, peaceful field must not be converted into hidden pathology or padded with invented conflict.
cases.anti_coherence_expectation: This field is deliberately coherent. Reward a clear, evidence-earned sea to guided path to shared garden relation; penalize only hidden pathology, unsupported developmental certainty, or poetic closure beyond the images.

entries.dream_narrative: Βρισκόμουν μέσα σε μια ήρεμη θάλασσα και ανέπνεα κανονικά κάτω από το νερό, χωρίς φόβο. Ένα λευκό πουλί κατέβηκε χαμηλά προς την επιφάνεια. Έμεινα ακίνητη και το παρατηρούσα να πλησιάζει.
symbol_stances: ήρεμη θάλασσα: αναπνέει μέσα της χωρίς φόβο
λευκό πουλί: το παρατηρεί να πλησιάζει
archetypal_echoes: Self (quiet coherence) — a calm organizing center
entries.interpretation_excerpt: Η γαλήνη μπορεί να διαβαστεί ως μια στιγμή συνοχής που δεν χρειάζεται να λυθεί.

entries.dream_narrative: Ένα μικρό κορίτσι με περίμενε στην αρχή ενός φωτεινού μονοπατιού. Μου έδωσε μια κόκκινη κλωστή και άρχισε να περπατά. Την ακολούθησα πρόθυμα, κρατώντας την κλωστή απαλά.
archetypal_echoes: Divine Child (gentle guide) — orientation carried through trust
mythic_echoes: Ariadne (Greek) — a thread offers orientation without coercion
entries.interpretation_excerpt: Η καθοδήγηση εμφανίζεται ως σχέση εμπιστοσύνης και όχι ως δοκιμασία.

entries.dream_narrative: Μπήκα σε έναν περιφραγμένο κήπο γεμάτο ώριμα σύκα. Κάθισα κάτω από ένα δέντρο με μια φίλη και μοιραστήκαμε ένα σύκο. Δεν βιαζόμασταν να φύγουμε.
symbol_stances: ώριμα σύκα: μοιράζεται ένα με φίλη
archetypal_echoes: Lover (warm mutuality) — intimacy held without urgency
entries.interpretation_excerpt: Το όνειρο κρατά μια απλή εμπειρία αφθονίας και συντροφικότητας.

cases.reviewer_focus: The Recent response should feel immediate and lighter than the paired monthly response.
cases.anti_coherence_expectation: This field is deliberately coherent. Reward the grounded sea, guide/thread, and garden relation while requiring a current pulse rather than a developmental monthly arc.

cases.reviewer_focus: Preserve contradiction and avoid inventing linear progress or a single solved thesis.
cases.anti_coherence_expectation: The door, train, and altered house support a concrete shared access/passage field, but their different stances do not support healing, resolution, or linear progress.

entries.dream_narrative: I stood in a narrow corridor before a locked red door. Warm light showed beneath it. I pushed twice, then stopped and listened, wanting to approach whatever was on the other side.
entries.interpretation_excerpt: The closed door may stage a guarded transition.

entries.dream_narrative: I was riding a fast train through open countryside. I had not chosen the route, but an open window let in strong wind. I leaned into it with relief as the station passed without stopping.
symbol_stances: train: rides without choosing the route
entries.interpretation_excerpt: Movement arrives, though direction remains externally set.

entries.dream_narrative: I entered my childhood house willingly and heard family voices in rooms I could not see. The staircase to the upper floor was missing. I felt comfort and unease together and waited instead of jumping.
symbol_stances: missing staircase: waits rather than jumping
archetypal_echoes: Mother (ambivalent holding) — shelter and unfamiliarity coexist
entries.interpretation_excerpt: The return does not resolve whether the house is refuge or displacement.

cases.reviewer_focus: A loose sequence should remain light and should not be forced into a grand unifying pattern.
cases.anti_coherence_expectation: This sequence is intentionally loose. It may name weak local affinities, but it should state that library, horse, and kitchen do not yet form one sufficiently dense field.

entries.dream_narrative: I entered a quiet library and checked the name on my library card twice. A librarian pointed toward a blue shelf. I browsed there without urgency and without looking for a particular book.
symbol_stances: library card: checks the name twice
entries.interpretation_excerpt: The scene may simply hold unhurried curiosity.

entries.dream_narrative: I rode a chestnut horse confidently across a windy field. A yellow scarf slipped from my neck and flew away. I was surprised, then laughed and kept riding.
symbol_stances: yellow scarf: lets it fly away
entries.interpretation_excerpt: The dream is carried by uncomplicated motion and pleasure.

entries.dream_narrative: A tap was leaking into the small kitchen sink. A neighbor lent me a tool, and I tightened the tap until it stopped. I placed a green cup under the last drops and felt satisfied.
symbol_stances: green cup: places it under the last drops
entries.interpretation_excerpt: A small obstacle is resolved without deeper conflict.
